name: Barbertime
description: Barbertime is a Romanian professional barber brand offering one of the widest product ranges in the industry — from waxes, pomades, and hair gels to shaving tools, after shave colognes, barber capes, accessories, and consumables. Built for the needs of the modern barbershop.

name: Rovra
tagline: Power and Precision in Every Cut
description: ROVRA builds high-performance professional barber tools trusted by top barbers worldwide. From precision clippers and trimmers to ultra-fast hair dryers and professional accessories, every product is engineered for demanding daily use.

name: Alveola
description: Alveola is a professional depilatory brand offering sugar paste and waxing products for gentle, effective hair removal.

name: Athina
description: Athina is a professional depilatory line offering film wax beads, elastic waxes, roll-on refills, paraffin, disposables and complete pre and after-wax care for smooth, effective salon hair removal.

name: Barbicide
description: Barbicide is the globally recognised leader in barbershop and salon disinfection. Since 1947, the iconic blue solution has set the gold standard for implement sanitation — trusted by professionals worldwide for safe, EPA-registered disinfection of combs, shears, clippers, and all reusable tools.

name: BIEMME
description: BIEMME is an Italian professional brand specialising in wax heaters and depilatory waxes engineered for reliable, efficient salon hair removal.

name: Binacil
description: Binacil is a professional German lash and brow tinting brand offering rich, long-lasting tints, developer and application accessories for precise salon results.

name: Depilflax
description: Depilflax is a leading Spanish professional depilatory brand offering a complete waxing system — elastic and film waxes, roll-on refills, paraffin, pre and after-wax care and accessories — trusted by salons for smooth, effective and comfortable hair removal.

name: DubaiAromas
description: DubaiAromas brings the rich tradition of Middle Eastern perfumery to the modern barbershop. Specialising in long-lasting aftershave colognes, eau de parfum, and signature fragrance blends inspired by the luxury scents of Dubai — crafted for a premium grooming finish.

name: EpilatPRO
description: EpilatPRO is a professional waxing and salon-essentials brand offering depilatory waxes, consumables and accessories for efficient, high-quality salon treatments.

name: Felce Azzurra
description: Felce Azzurra is an iconic Italian brand whose classic scented talc powder leaves the skin soft, dry and delicately fragranced.

name: FIAB
description: FIAB is an Italian professional medical-aesthetic brand offering radiofrequency (TECAR) therapy creams for professional body and facial treatments.

name: Glemen
description: Glemen is a rising Romanian professional barber brand engineered for the modern barbershop. The range spans high-shine and matte waxes, volume styling powders, premium aftershave colognes, salt sprays, menthol hair tonics, professional hairsprays, and beard care — all crafted to meet the highest salon standards.

name: Immortal
description: Born in the streets of New York, Immortal NYC delivers a complete professional grooming range trusted by barbers worldwide. The expanded catalog includes signature pomades, waxes, and styling gels (Venom, Samurai Spirit, Wild West, The Creed, Brilliante, Captain Black, Aventus, and more), aftershave colognes (One Million, Bay Rum, Sailors Anthem, Luxury Marine), eau de parfum, hair sprays, salt sprays, color sprays, professional shampoos and conditioners, beard oils and balms, face masks and scrubs, barber capes, and styling accessories.

name: JimJams
description: JimJams is a professional lash and brow tinting brand offering rich, long-lasting cream tints in a range of natural shades.

name: King Talc
description: King Talc offers finely milled, delicately scented talc powders that leave the skin smooth, dry and comfortable after grooming.

name: L3VEL3
description: L3VEL3 brings scientific precision to barbering across a complete professional range. From signature styling waxes (Matte Putty, Spider Wax, Glossy Pomade) and gels (Super Strong, Slime, Creamy) to aftershave colognes (Frost, Flame, Aqua, Houston, Royale), professional shampoos and conditioners, beard care, hair sprays, salt sprays, and a full lineup of barbering tools — stainless steel razors, capes, spray bottles, combs, brushes, mixing bowls, hair design pencils — plus salon coloring with cream developers, bleaching powder, and a vibrant 16-shade semi-permanent color palette.

name: LineaPRO
description: LineaPRO is a professional waxing and beauty line offering depilatory waxes, roll-on cartridges, paraffin and complete pre and after-wax care for reliable, salon-quality hair removal services.

name: MAXIMA
description: MAXIMA offers professional colour-care solutions, including hair-dye stain removers for a clean, tidy finish after colouring services.

name: Novicide
description: Novicide provides professional concentrated disinfectants and sterilisation containers for hygienic instrument care in salons and barbershops.

name: OCC Switzerland
description: OCC Switzerland provides professional Swiss-quality disinfectants for instruments and surfaces, ensuring the highest hygiene standards in the salon.

name: PREMIUM
description: PREMIUM supplies professional salon consumables — highlighting foils, disposables and body-wrap accessories — for everyday salon and spa use.

name: Quickepil
description: Quickepil is a professional Spanish waxing brand offering a full depilatory range — film and warm waxes, roll-on refills, and pre and after-wax care — designed for fast, comfortable and effective hair removal.

name: RefectoCil
tagline: The World Leader in Lash & Brow Tinting
description: RefectoCil is the world's leading professional eyelash and eyebrow tinting brand, made in Austria and trusted in over 70 countries. Its salon-proven tints, developers, primers and accessories deliver rich, long-lasting colour for precise, beautiful lash and brow results.

name: Roial
description: Roial is a professional waxing and salon-supply brand offering depilatory waxes, roll-on cartridges, disposables, foils and pre and after-wax care for reliable, comfortable hair-removal services.

name: Roial Disposables
description: Roial Disposables offers professional single-use salon consumables — caps, briefs, sheets, towels and gloves — for hygiene and comfort during treatments.

name: Roial iWAX
description: Roial iWAX is a professional roll-on waxing line offering cartridge waxes and applicators for fast, hygienic and precise hair removal.

name: SalonPRO
description: SalonPRO offers professional salon accessories and consumables for daily barbershop and salon operations.

name: Seyfnstein
description: Seyfnstein provides professional colour-cleaning solutions that remove tint and dye residue for a clean, professional finish.

name: SIEM
description: SIEM offers refreshing professional shower gels in vibrant fragrances that cleanse and revitalise the skin.

name: Silvermax
description: Silvermax is a specialist manufacturer of professional razor blades and shaving tools trusted by barbers across Europe. Offering single-edge and double-edge blade formats in Platinum and Super Platinum coatings, Silvermax delivers consistent sharpness, precision, and reliability — essential for professional wet shaving services in any barbershop.

name: SOFT
description: SOFT supplies professional single-use salon consumables — caps, slippers and shoe covers — for hygiene and comfort during treatments.

name: Spuma di Sciampagna
description: Spuma di Sciampagna is a classic Italian brand whose scented talc powder leaves the skin soft, dry and delicately fragranced.

name: Starpil
description: Starpil is a renowned Spanish professional waxing brand offering film waxes, warm waxes, roll-on cartridges and complete pre and after-wax care, trusted by estheticians worldwide for reliable, comfortable hair removal.

name: Xanitalia
description: Xanitalia is an Italian leader in professional depilatory waxes, backed by continuous investment in research and manufacturing. Trusted by beauty professionals across Europe, the brand offers a comprehensive range of hot waxes, film granules, sugar pastes, and pre/post-epilation care products — all engineered for precise, comfortable, and long-lasting hair removal results.

name: XanitaliaPro
description: XanitaliaPro is the professional equipment and accessories division of the Xanitalia Group. Specialising in professional-grade tools for hair salons, barbershops, and beauty studios — including precision clippers, trimmers, shavers, hair dusters, cutting capes, and salon accessories — all rigorously quality tested before release.
